title: PCSO Lotto Results: Lotto 6/42 bettor wins P10-M jackpot
summary: A Lotto 6/42 bettor from Quezon province clinched the P10-million jackpot in Saturday night's draw, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said.

blocks.text: A Lotto 6/42 bettor from Quezon province clinched the P10-million jackpot in Saturday night's draw, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said.
Meanwhile, no one won the jackpot in the Grand Lotto 6/55 draw, which offered a prize of P319,543,684.84.
No bettor correctly guessed the combination of 42-30-21-17-20-01.
